wikipediaSummary.title: Presenting the Fabulous Ronettes
wikipediaSummary.extract: Presenting the Fabulous Ronettes is the only studio album by the American girl group the Ronettes. Produced by Phil Spector and released in November 1964 through his label, Philles Records, the album collects the group's singles from 1963–1964. In 2003, it was ranked number 422 on Rolling Stone's list of "The 500 Greatest Albums of All Time". In Rolling Stone's 2023 revision to that list, the album was ranked 494.
